title: Squanto unites three rival tribes

tellings.quote: Uh Squanto unites creates this federation of these three tribes that were all rivals against each other

plain: A Native American man named Squanto, in what is now Massachusetts, is said to have brought together three tribes that had been rivals and formed them into a single federation. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells this on an episode with Michels about the pyramids, offering it as an example of one figure uniting peoples who had been at odds.
